MISSION CRITICAL (owner 2026-11-28, ledger entry 'domains connect to groups automatically'): (1) add-extraction refuses a figure with no lens ('an extraction must be stated in at least one lens (D-0182)'), so evidence is turned away for lacking a classification that judgment is meant to supply; (2) no table or view links a parameter's domain (terms.domain, for example the 17 circulation terms) to identities, ICF codes or access needs, so groups cannot follow from the domain; (3) evidence that cannot state its own domain must still be accepted so judgment assigns the domain and the groups. WORKAROUND: every code row of this session carries lens MOB, basis context, flagged provisional (override O12). PROPOSED: add-extraction accepts no lens and no domain and marks the row as awaiting judgment; a typed domain-to-lens mapping (identities, ICF, needs per domain, each with its warrant) read by judgment; a view listing extractions awaiting classification. Doctrine needed first: the mapping content is the owner's or an adjudication's, not a guess.
(168,)
===== extraction_lens_links
CREATE TABLE "extraction_lens_links" (
    link_id             INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    extraction_id       INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES source_value_extractions(extraction_id),
    -- THE THREE LENSES, typed, one per row (2026-08-28 shape; "never two lenses in one row").
    identity_code       TEXT REFERENCES base_taxonomy_identity(identity_code),
    icf_code            TEXT REFERENCES base_icf(icf_code),
    needs_code          TEXT REFERENCES access_needs(need_code),
    -- THE WARRANT (rule 8: a judgment records its answer and its evidence in named columns).
    --   named_in_text       the figure's own words name the users / function / need (D-2)
    --   heading             the provision names no one; its heading names the group (OD-31)
    --   study_participants  a study's own participants are this group (2026-08-25 grade rule)
    --   context             a code value (tier 4 to 6) whose clause names no group: its context warrants the link, by
    --                       the recording session's judgment (OD-65; sixteenth set, as corrected 2026-11-15)
    --   carried             moved by migration 131 from the retired column; no judged warrant yet
    basis               TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (basis IN
                            ('named_in_text', 'heading', 'study_participants', 'context', 'carried')),
    basis_text          TEXT,          -- the exact words that warrant the link (for `context`: the words stating the context)
    basis_reason        TEXT,          -- `context` only: the recording session's judgment, in its own words
    retired_at          TEXT,
    retired_by_session  TEXT,
    retirement_reason   TEXT,
    created_at          TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_by_session  TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at          TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_by_session  TEXT NOT NULL,
    CHECK ((identity_code IS NOT NULL) + (icf_code IS NOT NULL)
         + (needs_code IS NOT NULL) = 1),
    CHECK ((basis = 'carried') = (basis_text IS NULL)),
    CHECK (basis_text IS NULL OR length(trim(basis_text)) > 0),
    CHECK ((basis = 'context') = (basis_reason IS NOT NULL)),
    CHECK (basis_reason IS NULL OR length(trim(basis_reason)) > 0),
    CHECK ((retired_at IS NULL) = (retired_by_session IS NULL)
       AND (retired_at IS NULL) = (retirement_reason IS NULL))
)
===== source_value_extractions
CREATE TABLE "source_value_extractions" (
  extraction_id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,

  -- THE HAND-OFF KEY (D-0168; pinned by the blocking judgment_handoff_shape check):
  -- NOT NULL, a real FK at the evidence item, and NO UNIQUE index over it anywhere.
  ref_id                 TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES evidence_sources(ref_id),

  -- The slug this extraction was mined under: HISTORY. No writer sets it after migration 114 (the scan
  -- contract, LED-195: a slug guides what is searched, not what is read from a source), so it is NULL on every
  -- later row. The admission record is source_slug_links.
  slug                   TEXT REFERENCES slugs(slug),

  -- THE SUBJECT (owner 2026-08-26), now mandatory. Was nullable with `parameter` /
  -- `parameter_canonical` beside it; a NOT NULL free-text parameter NAME sitting next to
  -- a mandatory pointer at the registry that holds that same name is the dual home rule 5
  -- forbids. The name is reached: base_parameters.term_id -> terms.canonical_en.
  --
  -- AND THE VERBATIM PHRASE IS NOT LOST WITH IT. `parameter` was documented (schemas/
  -- source_value_extraction.py) as "the SOURCE's own phrase for what it measures,
  -- verbatim and unjudged (R11/D-0173)". That fact already has a purpose-built home with
  -- a live writer and 33 live rows: `observed_terms.surface_form`, whose own DDL comment
  -- reads "The phrase EXACTLY as the source writes it. Not normalised, not translated,
  -- not mapped. R11 forbids back-translation and this is where that starts" -- keyed
  -- UNIQUE (ref_id, surface_form, language), with `locator` and `context_quote`, written
  -- by `db.py observe-term` and adjudicated by `adjudicate-term` (migration 068, D-0173).
  -- CLAUDE.md §6 orders exactly that split: "harvest concepts at evidence (db.py
  -- observe-term, verbatim and unjudged), adjudicate at judgment." `parameter` was the
  -- duplicate, and an UNREALISED one -- 0 rows, no writer, ever. Clause-level verbatim
  -- survives here in `claim_text` ("exact source phrasing") plus `source_section` and the
  -- 16 `loc_*` columns.
  --
  -- KNOWN RESIDUAL, stated rather than papered over: an extraction cannot say WHICH of
  -- its source's observations it was read from. Closing that is an `observation_id`
  -- pointer, and it is NOT added here because nothing would read it -- "an unread field,
  -- an uncalled script and an unregistered check are the same defect" (CLAUDE.md §8). Add
  -- it in the change that gives it a reader.
  parameter_id           INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES base_parameters(parameter_id),

  -- THE THREE LENSES: HISTORY since migration 131 (OR-1c). A figure's lens is a set of rows in
  -- extraction_lens_links, read through v_live_lens_links; these four columns are held NULL by the CHECK
  -- at the foot of this table and are never written again. They are kept because committed data
  -- migrations INSERT them (CLAUDE.md rule 5: a column a committed data migration INSERTs can never be
  -- dropped). Until 131 they were real typed FKs, one per lens (owner 2026-08-28, replacing
  -- `population_code` and the free-text `population_label`), under D-0182's "at least one" CHECK.
  identity_code          TEXT REFERENCES "base_taxonomy_identity"(identity_code),
  icf_code               TEXT REFERENCES base_icf(icf_code),
  needs_code             TEXT REFERENCES access_needs(need_code),

  jurisdiction           TEXT,
  setting                TEXT,

  claim_type             TEXT NOT NULL
                           CHECK (claim_type IN ('numerical','range','qualitative','framework','absent')),
  claimed_value          TEXT,
  claimed_unit           TEXT,
  claim_text             TEXT,
  source_section         TEXT,

  -- Value genealogy / independence substrate (DR-2026-07-13 H1), carried across
  -- unchanged. v_value_independence counts distinct roots over these.
  root_id                TEXT REFERENCES external_root_registry(root_id),   -- registry-only (R24); an in-corpus root is root_ref_id
  root_type              TEXT
                           CHECK (root_type IN (
                             'measurement_primary', 'participatory_finding',
                             'committee_assertion', 'derived_calculation', 'untraced')),
  root_ref_id            TEXT REFERENCES evidence_sources(ref_id),
  echo_of                TEXT,
  measurement_paradigm   TEXT
                           CHECK (measurement_paradigm IN (
                             'swept_path_dynamic', 'static_turning_circle', 'static_clearance',
                             'anthropometric_percentile', 'instrumented_physical_measurement',
                             'route_metric', 'field_observation', 'participatory_spatial',
                             'stated_unmeasured')),
  device_class           TEXT
                           CHECK (device_class IN (
                             'manual_self_propelled', 'manual_attendant', 'power_chair', 'scooter',
                             'bariatric_manual', 'bariatric_power', 'walker_rollator',
                             'lower_limb_prosthesis', 'crutches', 'cane',
                             'mixed', 'not_device_scoped')),
  root_population_note   TEXT,
  root_classification_basis TEXT,
  contested              INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
                           CHECK (contested IN (0, 1)),
  file_anchor            TEXT,

  -- Pinpoint locator hierarchy (migration 053), carried across unchanged. These are the
  -- clause-level address that makes D-0168's 1:N fan-out legible: NBC 3.8's many clauses
  -- are many rows, and these columns are what tells them apart.
  locator_scheme         TEXT,
  loc_division           TEXT,
  loc_part               TEXT,
  loc_section            TEXT,
  loc_subsection         TEXT,
  loc_paragraph          TEXT,
  loc_clause             TEXT,
  loc_subclause          TEXT,
  loc_division_end       TEXT,
  loc_part_end           TEXT,
  loc_section_end        TEXT,
  loc_subsection_end     TEXT,
  loc_paragraph_end      TEXT,
  loc_clause_end         TEXT,
  loc_subclause_end      TEXT,
  loc_note               TEXT,

  extraction_method      TEXT NOT NULL
                           CHECK (extraction_method IN ('skim','full-read','re-read','auto-mined')),
  extraction_status      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'preliminary'
                           CHECK (extraction_status IN ('preliminary','reviewed','verified','contradicted','absent-confirmed')),
  promoted_to_rdc_id     TEXT REFERENCES reasoning_doc_citations(citation_id),
  notes                  TEXT,

  created_at             TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_by_session     TEXT,
  updated_at             TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_by_session     TEXT, figure_role TEXT
  CHECK (figure_role IS NULL OR figure_role IN ('claim', 'finding', 'condition', 'derived')), comparator TEXT
  CHECK (comparator IS NULL OR comparator IN ('=', '<', '<=', '>', '>=', 'between', 'approx')), harm_finding INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
  CHECK (harm_finding IN (0, 1))
  CHECK (harm_finding = 0 OR figure_role = 'finding'), value_as_written TEXT CHECK (value_as_written IS NULL OR length(trim(value_as_written)) > 0), clause_id INTEGER REFERENCES source_clauses(clause_id), retired_at TEXT, retired_by_session TEXT, retirement_reason TEXT
  CHECK ((retired_at IS NULL) = (retired_by_session IS NULL) AND (retired_at IS NULL) = (retirement_reason IS NULL)
         AND (retired_at IS NULL OR (length(trim(retired_at)) > 0 AND length(trim(retired_by_session)) > 0
                                     AND length(trim(retirement_reason)) > 0))),

  -- Carried across verbatim: if claim_type='absent', claimed_value must be NULL; if it
  -- is anything else, claimed_value must be present. `db.py add-extraction` refuses both
  -- violations in words BEFORE the INSERT, so an operator gets a sentence rather than
  -- "CHECK constraint failed".
  CHECK (
    (claim_type =  'absent' AND claimed_value IS NULL) OR
    (claim_type <> 'absent' AND claimed_value IS NOT NULL)
  ),

  -- HISTORY, retired by migration 131: a figure's lens lives in extraction_lens_links (OR-1c,
  -- owner 2026-11-06). The four columns are kept because committed data migrations INSERT them (rule 5:
  -- a column a committed data migration INSERTs can never be dropped) and are held NULL here; never
  -- written again. D-0182 (a link must be tied to at least one lens) moved to the writers and to the
  -- blocking test_db_integrity case that reads v_live_lens_links.
  CHECK (COALESCE(identity_code, icf_code, needs_code) IS NULL)
)
===== v_live_lens_links
CREATE VIEW v_live_lens_links AS
SELECT k.link_id, k.extraction_id, k.identity_code, k.icf_code, k.needs_code,
       k.basis, k.basis_text, k.basis_reason, k.created_at, k.created_by_session
  FROM extraction_lens_links k
  JOIN source_value_extractions x ON x.extraction_id = k.extraction_id AND x.retired_at IS NULL
 WHERE k.retired_at IS NULL
===== v_item_provenance
CREATE VIEW v_item_provenance AS
SELECT
    bp.parameter_id,
    t.canonical_en              AS parameter_name,
    t.domain                    AS parameter_domain,
    ecs.specification_id,
    COALESCE(ecs.identity_code, ecs.icf_code, ecs.needs_code) AS lens_code,
    ecs.state                   AS cell_state,
    ecs.tier_basis,
    ecs.regulatory_stratum_only,
    csl.role                    AS source_role,
    es.ref_id,
    es.pub_title,
    -- POINTER, NOT COPY (migration 063). Was `es.author_display`, a writer-retired
    -- tombstone reading NULL. The authors have one home, evidence_source_authors, and
    -- v_evidence_authors renders it.
    va.author_display,
    es.pub_year,
    es.tier                     AS source_tier,
    es.evidence_type,
    es.verification_status,
    es.jurisdiction
FROM base_parameters bp
JOIN terms t                            ON t.term_id           = bp.term_id
JOIN "specifications" ecs               ON ecs.parameter_id    = bp.parameter_id
JOIN "specification_source_links" csl   ON csl.specification_id = ecs.specification_id
JOIN evidence_sources es                ON es.ref_id           = csl.ref_id
                                        AND es.superseded_by_ref_id IS NULL
LEFT JOIN v_evidence_authors va         ON va.ref_id           = es.ref_id
WHERE ecs.retired_at IS NULL
  AND bp.status = 'active'
===== terms
CREATE TABLE terms (
    term_id             TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    canonical_en        TEXT NOT NULL,
    definition          TEXT,
    domain              TEXT,
    scope_note          TEXT,
    created_at          TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_by_session  TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at          TEXT NOT NULL,

# The identity and ICF lenses have a hierarchy (their registry carries `parent_code`; `dbcore.family_sql`): a cell keyed on a code
# gathers the figures linked to that code or to any code whose parent_code chain reaches it (T-055, OD-75). Derived from
# the registry on every gather, never a list. UNION, not UNION ALL, so a cycle ends.


def _lens_clause(conn, lens, alias):
    """`AND <every lens the cell states is among the figure's live links>` and its parameters.

    A lens with a hierarchy (`dbcore.family_sql`: identity, ICF) counts through `parent_code` (a parent's cell gathers its
    descendants' figures, a child's only its own); the predicate stays inside the per-figure EXISTS, so a figure carrying two codes of one family is
    gathered once and no count downstream multiplies by its number of links.

    A figure reaches a cell when, for each lens the cell states, it has a live link carrying that
    code; a lens the cell leaves NULL imposes nothing (T-018 design section 4). Read from
    `v_live_lens_links`, never from the retired lens columns of `source_value_extractions`, and
    never through a crossing map (D-0184): a figure tagged for another group, or for everyone,
    does not reach a cell that does not state that tag (OR-1b). A cell stating no lens would
    impose nothing and gather by parameter alone, which is the defect this closes, so it is refused."""
    parts = [(f"EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM v_live_lens_links k WHERE "
              f"k.extraction_id = {alias}.extraction_id AND k.{c} "
              + f"IN {dbcore.family_sql(conn, c)})", lens[c])
             for c in LENS_ORDER if lens.get(c)]
    if not parts:
        raise Refusal("a cell states at least one lens (D-0182); gathering without one would "
                      "select evidence by parameter alone")
    return "AND " + " AND ".join(p for p, _ in parts), tuple(v for _, v in parts)

    which must be found on word boundaries, in the place the basis names:

      named_in_text       the figure's claim_text, or a file saved for its source (D-2: its own words name the users);
      heading             the figure's source_section, its own heading (OD-31);
      study_participants  the study_population of an evidence_population_match row for the source (2026-08-25);
      context             the figure's claim_text, its source_section, or a file saved for its source (the scope,
                          application or purpose clause): the words that state the clause's context, with
                          `basis_reason`, the recording session's judgment (OD-65; the sixteenth set of 2026-11-14,
                          as corrected 2026-11-15). Only on a source of tier 4 or above, the regulatory stratum: the
                          owner moved the assignment for code values only, so a research figure's group still comes
                          from its own words or its study's participants.

    `basis_reason` is given with `context` and with no other basis (a reason beside a stated warrant is a cell with no
    meaning). Returns (the stripped text, the stripped reason or None). WHAT THIS DOES NOT CHECK: that the words name
    the lens code itself. The registries
    do not hold a name for every code (about half the ICF d-codes have no title, access_needs has no name column), so a name test cannot be derived for them; whether the words name the group
    is the judge's (D-2) and the recorded warrant is what a later reader audits."""
    allowed = set(_lens_basis_choices() or ())
    if basis not in allowed:
        raise Refusal(
            f"{context}: a lens link needs --lens-basis / --basis, one of {sorted(allowed)} (the warrant for "
            f"stating the figure in this group). Nothing was written.")
    reason = None if basis_reason is None else str(basis_reason).strip()
    if basis != "context" and reason is not None:
        raise Refusal(
            f"{context}: a reason (--lens-basis-reason / --basis-reason) is the recording session's judgment and "
            f"belongs to basis `context` only; basis {basis} rests on the source's own words, so a reason beside it "
            f"would be a cell with no meaning. Nothing was written.")
    if basis == "context":
        tier = conn.execute("SELECT tier FROM evidence_sources WHERE ref_id=?", (ref_id,)).fetchone()
        if not (tier and tier[0] is not None and int(tier[0]) >= dbcore.REGULATORY_FROM_TIER):
            raise Refusal(
                f"{context}: basis `context` is for a code value (a source of tier 4 to 6); {ref_id} is tier "
                f"{tier[0] if tier else None}. The owner moved the contextual assignment of a lens to the recording "
                f"call for code values only (the sixteenth set, 2026-11-14: grep -n -F \"Owner instruction 2026-11-14 "
                f"(sixteenth set)\" references/project-standards.md); a research figure's group comes from its own "
                f"words (named_in_text, heading) or its study's participants. Nothing was written.")
        if not reason or not re.search(r"[^\W\d_]", reason):
            raise Refusal(
                f"{context}: basis `context` needs --lens-basis-reason / --basis-reason: your judgment, in words, "
                f"of why the clause's context warrants the link (for a mounting height: 'typically concerns "
                f"wheelchair users'). Nothing was written.")
    text = (basis_text or "").strip()
    if not text:
        raise Refusal(
            f"{context}: the warrant's words are blank. Give --lens-basis-text / --basis-text: the exact words "
            f"of the figure, its heading or its study's participants that name the group. Nothing was written.")
    if not re.search(r"\w", text):
        raise Refusal(f"{context}: the warrant {text!r} holds no letter or digit, so it names no one. "
                      f"Nothing was written.")
    if basis == "named_in_text":
        where = f"the figure's claim_text, or a file saved for {ref_id}"
        found = _as_whole_words(text, claim_text) or _saved_text_has(text, ref_id)
    elif basis == "context":
        where = f"the figure's claim_text, its source_section, or a file saved for {ref_id}"
        found = (_as_whole_words(text, claim_text) or _as_whole_words(text, source_section)
                 or _saved_text_has(text, ref_id))
    elif basis == "heading":
        where = "the figure's source_section (its heading)"
        found = _as_whole_words(text, source_section)
    else:
        where = f"the study_population of an evidence_population_match row for {ref_id}"
        found = any(_as_whole_words(text, r[0]) for r in conn.execute(
            "SELECT study_population FROM evidence_population_match WHERE source_ref=?", (ref_id,)))
    if not found:
        raise Refusal(
            f"{context}: the warrant {text!r} (basis {basis}) is not, on word boundaries, in {where}. A link "
            f"rests on words the source holds, never on memory (CLAUDE.md 5(c)); a basis names where to look: "
            f"named_in_text the claim text or the source's saved file, heading the source_section, "
            f"study_participants the graded study_population, context the claim text, the source_section or the "
            f"source's saved file (its scope, application or purpose clause). Nothing was written.")
    return text, reason

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
scripts/audit/code_value_identity_audit.py -- a code value whose codes the maps tie to a group, with no identity written, is listed.

WHAT WRONG THING REACHES THE GUIDEBOOK WITHOUT IT (T-126): a code value silently absent from every cell of a group it
serves. The writer's warning (`db.py add-extraction` / `add-lens-link`: "WARNING: maps propose ...") is seen once, by
the session that wrote the row; the engine reaches a cell only through the lens links written on a figure (D-0184,
OR-1), so a stored code value whose recorder left out every group its codes propose is otherwise invisible. Subject
and findings are derived from the live tables on each run; the proposals are the writer's own query
(`db.identity_proposals`).

Prints `EXAMINED: <n>`, the live figures of sources of tier 4 or above (the regulatory stratum) with any live lens
link; a derived line, never a failure, counting those that carry no identity link that is judged (not `carried`) and
not `ALL` (the queue the one-time pass over stored code values, T-127, works); then
  (i)   by extraction id, every such figure with live ICF or access-need links, no live identity link and at least
        one proposal, with its proposals (`ALL` is not an identity, OD-31); a figure whose every live link has basis `heading` is left out (OD-31: a
        heading that names no group gives no identity). A figure whose recorder judged that no proposed group is served
        stays here (OD-47, still the owner's, decides whether such a judgment needs a row of its own);
  (ii)  for information, every live identity (the scope marker aside) no live map row proposes;
  (iii) for information, every such figure for which a map row (or the access_need_icf row it is reached through)
        created after the figure's newest live lens link proposes an identity the figure does not carry: the figures
        recorded before the base could propose a group, for a later lens pass. It clears when the session writes a
        link (a live link newer than the map row);
  (iv)  for information, the figures with no ICF or need link: those whose only identity is the scope marker (they
        reach no group cell: the harm this audit names) and those reached only through carried, unjudged identity
        links, each counted and listed by id.

Usage:  python3 scripts/audit/code_value_identity_audit.py
Exit 0 list (i) is empty; 1 it is not; 2 cannot run. Lists (ii) to (iv) and the queue line never set the exit code. The registry level,
not the exit code, makes it advisory.
"""
import os
import sqlite3
import sys
from pathlib import Path

REPO = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
sys.path.insert(0, str(REPO / "scripts"))
import db                                                              # noqa: E402
import dbcore                                                          # noqa: E402

DB_PATH = Path(os.environ.get("GUIDEBOOK_DB_PATH", REPO / "data" / "guidebook.db"))


def main():
    if not DB_PATH.exists():
        print(f"code_value_identity_audit: no database at {DB_PATH}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2
    conn = sqlite3.connect(f"file:{DB_PATH}?mode=ro", uri=True)
    try:
        figs = conn.execute(
            "SELECT DISTINCT k.extraction_id, MAX(datetime(k.created_at)) OVER (PARTITION BY k.extraction_id) "
            "FROM v_live_lens_links k JOIN source_value_extractions x ON x.extraction_id = k.extraction_id "
            "JOIN evidence_sources e ON e.ref_id = x.ref_id WHERE e.tier >= ? ORDER BY k.extraction_id", (dbcore.REGULATORY_FROM_TIER,)).fetchall()
        marker = dbcore.SCOPE_MARKER_IDENTITY                              # not a group (OD-31)
        omitted, late, queue, only_marker, only_carried = [], [], 0, [], []
        for eid, newest in figs:
            links = conn.execute("SELECT identity_code, icf_code, needs_code, basis FROM v_live_lens_links "
                                 "WHERE extraction_id=?", (eid,)).fetchall()
            ids = {r[0] for r in links if r[0] and r[0] != marker}
            queue += not any(r[0] and r[0] != marker and r[3] != "carried" for r in links)
            icf, needs = [r[1] for r in links if r[1]], [r[2] for r in links if r[2]]
            if not icf and not needs:                     # reached only through its identity links, if at all
                if not ids:
                    only_marker.append(eid)
                elif all(r[3] == "carried" for r in links):
                    only_carried.append(eid)
            props = db.identity_proposals(conn, icf, needs)
            if not ids and (icf or needs) and props and any(r[3] != "heading" for r in links):
                omitted.append((eid, props))
            fresh = sorted({p["identity_code"] for p in props if p["identity_code"] not in ids and any(
                t and conn.execute("SELECT datetime(?) > ?", (t, newest)).fetchone()[0]
                for t in (p["map_created_at"], p["need_row_created_at"]))})
            if fresh:
                late.append((eid, fresh))
        unproposed = [c for (c,) in conn.execute(
            "SELECT identity_code FROM base_taxonomy_identity WHERE status='active' AND identity_code <> ? AND "
            "identity_code NOT IN (SELECT identity_code FROM identity_icf_map WHERE retired_at IS NULL) "
            "ORDER BY identity_code", (marker,))]
    finally:
        conn.close()
    print("code_value_identity_audit -- a code value whose codes the maps tie to a group, with no identity written, is listed")
    print(f"EXAMINED: {len(figs)}")
    print(f"queue (derived, not a failure): {queue} of these figures carry no identity link that is judged (basis other "
          f"than carried) and not {marker}; the one-time lens pass over stored code values (T-127) works this queue")
    print(f"(i) figures with ICF or need links, no identity link but the scope marker, and a proposal: {len(omitted)}")
    for eid, props in omitted:
        print(f"  extraction {eid}: maps propose " + ", ".join(
            f"{p['identity_code']} (via {p['icf_code']}; {p['mapping_confidence']}, {p['provenance']})" for p in props))
    print(f"(ii) live identities no map row proposes (information): {', '.join(unproposed) or 'none'}")
    print(f"(iii) figures a map row newer than their newest live link proposes a group for (information): {len(late)}")
    for eid, codes in late:
        print(f"  extraction {eid}: {', '.join(codes)}")
    print(f"(iv) figures with no ICF or need link (information, the lens passes' queue): {len(only_marker)} carry no "
          f"identity but {marker}, so reach no group cell: {', '.join(map(str, only_marker)) or 'none'}; "
          f"{len(only_carried)} are reached only through carried (unjudged) identity links: "
          f"{', '.join(map(str, only_carried)) or 'none'}")
    return 1 if omitted else 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

===== identity_need_icf
CREATE TABLE identity_need_icf (
    triple_id           INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    identity_code       TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES base_taxonomy_identity(identity_code),
    need_code           TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES access_needs(need_code),
    icf_code            TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES base_icf(icf_code),
    state               TEXT NOT NULL
                        CHECK (state IN ('stated', 'provisional', 'pending', 'not_applicable')),
    warrant             TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(warrant)) > 0),
    created_at          TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_by_session  TEXT NOT NULL,
    -- THE OWNER'S REVIEW: the heading of the ledger entry that records it, the time, and the session that ran the verb.
    review_ref          TEXT CHECK (review_ref IS NULL OR review_ref LIKE 'Owner%'),
    reviewed_at         TEXT,
    reviewed_session    TEXT,
    review_note         TEXT CHECK (review_note IS NULL OR length(trim(review_note)) > 0),
    retired_at          TEXT,
    retired_by_session  TEXT,
    retirement_reason   TEXT,
    retirement_ref      TEXT CHECK (retirement_ref IS NULL OR retirement_ref LIKE 'Owner%'),
    CHECK ((review_ref IS NULL) = (reviewed_at IS NULL) AND (review_ref IS NULL) = (reviewed_session IS NULL)),
    CHECK (state NOT IN ('stated', 'provisional') OR reviewed_at IS NOT NULL),
    CHECK (state <> 'pending' OR reviewed_at IS NULL),
    CHECK ((state = 'provisional') = (review_note IS NOT NULL)),
    CHECK ((retired_at IS NULL AND retired_by_session IS NULL AND retirement_reason IS NULL AND retirement_ref IS NULL)
        OR (retired_at IS NOT NULL AND retired_by_session IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(retirement_reason)) > 0
            AND retirement_ref IS NOT NULL))
)
===== access_need_icf
CREATE TABLE "access_need_icf" (
  need_code   TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES access_needs(need_code),
  icf_code    TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES base_icf(icf_code),                       -- 'e250','b765','d510' …
  icf_type    TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (icf_type IN ('b','d','e','s')),
  confidence  TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (confidence IN ('confirmed','proposed')),
  notes        TEXT,
  created_at  TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
  created_by_session TEXT,
  PRIMARY KEY (need_code, icf_code)
)
===== identity_icf_map
CREATE TABLE "identity_icf_map" (
    link_id             INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    identity_code     TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES "base_taxonomy_identity"(identity_code),
    icf_code            TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES base_icf(icf_code),
    mechanism           TEXT NOT NULL,
    mapping_confidence  TEXT NOT NULL
                        CHECK (mapping_confidence IN ('high_predictive',
                                                      'moderate_contextual',
                                                      'low_indicative')),
    -- WHERE THIS ROW CAME FROM. A mapping with no provenance is the skill prose again,
    -- in a table. 'fda-skill-2026-09-13' is the promotion of the audited markdown; a
    -- later row derived from a study names its ref_id.
    provenance          TEXT NOT NULL,
    notes               TEXT,
    created_at          TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_by_session  TEXT NOT NULL, retired_at TEXT, retired_by_session TEXT, retired_reason TEXT
    CHECK ((retired_at IS NULL AND retired_by_session IS NULL AND retired_reason IS NULL)
        OR (retired_at IS NOT NULL AND retired_by_session IS NOT NULL AND retired_reason IS NOT NULL)),
    -- One row per (population, code, mechanism): the same population may reach one ICF
    -- code by two different mechanisms (SCI is "biomechanical + autonomic"), and both are
    -- real. Collapsing them would lose the distinction the mechanism column exists for.
    UNIQUE (identity_code, icf_code, mechanism)
)
===== v_lens_crosswalk
CREATE VIEW v_lens_crosswalk AS
SELECT t.triple_id, t.identity_code, i.display_name AS identity_name,
       t.need_code, n.design_obligation AS need_obligation,
       t.icf_code, c.title AS icf_title,
       t.state, t.warrant, t.review_note, t.review_ref, t.reviewed_at, t.created_by_session
  FROM identity_need_icf t
  JOIN base_taxonomy_identity i ON i.identity_code = t.identity_code
  JOIN access_needs n           ON n.need_code     = t.need_code
  JOIN base_icf c               ON c.icf_code      = t.icf_code
 WHERE t.retired_at IS NULL
===== access_needs
CREATE TABLE access_needs (
  need_code       TEXT PRIMARY KEY,               -- 'A-NOSIGHT' …
  family          TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (family IN
                    ('perceiving','communicating','operating','pacing','environment_safety')),
  design_obligation TEXT NOT NULL,                 -- "the design must …"
  absorbs         TEXT,                            -- populations/situations it covers (prose, audit-side)
  typical_stakes  TEXT CHECK (typical_stakes IN ('safety-critical','exclusion','friction')),
  source_version  TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'access-taxonomy v0.1',
  notes           TEXT,
  created_at      TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
  created_by_session TEXT
)
===== term_adjudications
CREATE TABLE term_adjudications (
    adjudication_id     INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    observation_id      INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES observed_terms(observation_id),
    -- OUTCOMES, documented HERE and not inside the CHECK. dbcore.check_values() reads
    -- this constraint's own value list to build the CLI's refusal, and an inline
    -- comment between the quoted values defeats its parser -- measured 2026-09-03,
    -- when a first cut of this migration carried the descriptions inside the IN(...)
    -- and every legitimate outcome was refused with a mangled vocabulary. The whole
    -- reason vocabularies come from the schema rather than a list in the code
    -- (CLAUDE.md §4) is defeated by punctuation the parser cannot see past.
    --
    --   NAMES-EXISTING  names a term we already hold
    --   NAMES-NEW       names a concept new to the vocabulary
    --   NOT-OURS        a real phrase, but not one of our concepts
    --   DEFERRED        cannot be settled on this source alone
    outcome             TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (outcome IN
                            ('NAMES-EXISTING','NAMES-NEW','NOT-OURS','DEFERRED')),
    term_id             TEXT REFERENCES terms(term_id),
    -- NOT NULL: an adjudication that does not say why cannot be contested, and the
    -- whole point of splitting observation from judgment is that the judgement is
    -- inspectable.
    rationale           TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at          TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_by_session  TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at          TEXT,
    updated_by_session  TEXT,
    -- The outcome and the pointer must agree. An outcome that names a term must name
    -- one; an outcome that declines must not.
    CHECK (
        (outcome IN ('NAMES-EXISTING','NAMES-NEW') AND term_id IS NOT NULL)
     OR (outcome IN ('NOT-OURS','DEFERRED')        AND term_id IS NULL)
    )
